1.name: Berserker Spirit

1.name: Exhaustion

1.name: Flameburst

1.name: Invisibility versus Animals

4.name: Blind

4.description: Cures your target, removing one Disease effect.

4.description: Cure your target, removing one Poison effect.

4.description: Conjure a magical gate, returning you to your bind location. This spell has a slight chance to fail. This spell has no effect if you are encumbered.

4.description: Shower healing spores on a friendly target, healing them 10 Health every 6 seconds for 24 seconds.

4.name: Howling Cold
4.description: Rend your target with spiritual frost, dealing 11 (L4) to 14 (L7) Cold Damage.

4.name: Invisibility
4.description: Shroud a target group member in a cloak of invisibility, rendering them unseen by the living for 10 minutes.

4.name: Soulbind
4.description: Bind the soul of a target group member to their current location, causing them to respawn there upon death. This spell has no effect in certain areas.

4.name: Susceptibility
4.description: Makes your target more susceptible to ailments, decreasing their Disease, Poison, and Magic Resistance by 1 (L1) to 2 (L8) for 5 minutes. This spell cannot be resisted unless the target is immune to Magic effects.

8.name: Dispel Magic
8.description: Dispel magic from your target, removing one harmful effect.

8.name: Enervation
8.description: Enervate your target, slowing their Melee and Ranged Attack Speed by 20% for 2 minutes.

8.description: Haste your target, increasing their Melee and Ranged Attack Speed by 10% (L4) to 15% (L16) for 1h.

8.description: Summons a flask of water, providing you with sustenance. This item can be traded to other players. This item does not persist after logging out.
